ai.title: Fix diff block parsing regex
ai.summary: Updated `blockRegex` in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to make newlines optional before separators (`\n?`). Fixes parsing failures for diff blocks lacking trailing newlines. Internal backend change.

eli5.text: The system that reads and organizes code changes now handles cases where those changes don't end with a line break, which previously caused it to misread or skip them entirely. This affects anyone relying on those parsed changes behind the scenes, like automated code review tools. The fix made the parser's matching rule more forgiving by letting the line break before section markers be optional, so it grabs the right pieces whether or not a trailing newline is there.

ai.title: Add Twitch chat integration script for Codebuff
ai.summary: New `npm-app/twitch-plays-codebuff.sh` script polls Twitch chat via robotty.de API and injects messages into a tmux session running Codebuff. Updates `npm-app/knowledge.md` to document this testing infrastructure and the API integration details. Scope limited to repo tooling and internal documentation.

eli5.text: A developer added a new script that lets Twitch chat messages be sent directly into the Codebuff coding tool running inside a terminal window. Every minute, the script checks a special website for the latest chat message and types it into the Codebuff session as if someone were typing it manually. This affects anyone running Codebuff during testing, because their terminal will start receiving chat input from Twitch viewers. The feature is documented internally for testing purposes and is limited to the development environment.

ai.title: Pricing page updates overage rules and credit estimates
ai.summary: Pricing page clarifies overage policies: Free tier adds 'No overage allowed', while Paid and Pro Plus tiers standardize on 'Overage allowed' with explicit rates ($0.99 and $0.90 per 100 credits). Intense work session credit estimate revised from 500-1000 to 500. Changes isolated to web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx.

eli5.text: If you look at the pricing page today, the rules for paid tiers now clearly state you can go over your credit limit and exactly how much each extra batch of 100 credits costs: $0.99 for the $99/month tier and $0.90 for the $500/month tier. The free tier, by contrast, shows 'No overage allowed,' so you simply can't exceed its limit. The example that explains how many credits an intense one-hour session uses has also been simplified from a range to a single number: 500 credits.

ai.title: Skip knowledge file writes for placeholder content
ai.summary: Added guards in `process-file-block.ts` to return null if new content is `[UPDATED_BY_ANOTHER_ASSISTANT]` or starts with `@@`. `main-prompt.ts` now injects the placeholder marker instead of actual file blocks for knowledge updates. `generate-knowledge-files.ts` propagates change metadata to handle these skipped writes.

eli5.text: The assistant now skips writing knowledge files when the intended update is just a placeholder marker '[UPDATED_BY_ANOTHER_ASSISTANT]' or starts with '@@', which previously could overwrite or corrupt real content. This affects internal knowledge file generation for developers and assistants who update documentation during code changes. If you looked at the system behavior, you would notice that updates marked with the placeholder text are now ignored instead of overwriting the actual file content, preventing accidental loss or corruption of important knowledge files.
